app.title: The ZINN App
app.description: Ukuqwalasela iinkolelo ezisekelwe kwi-CBT ngezibonakaliso ze-AI

settingsDialogs.themeDesc: Khetha inkqubo oyithandayo okanye itshintshe ngokuzenzela ngokwexesha losuku.

beliefs.title: Iinkolelo Neziqinisekiso
beliefs.subtitle: Faka iinkolelo zakho, iziqinisekiso, nefilosofi. I-AI iza kuzidibanisa kwaye zihlukaniswe.
beliefs.enterPlaceholder: Faka {type} yakho... Iingaceba namagama ongawaziyo okanye uwe kubanye abantu...
beliefs.analyzing: I-AI iqwalasela inkolelo yakho ize ikhiqize okudibeneyo...
beliefs.noEntriesDesc: Faka inkolelo yakho yokuqala, isiqinisekiso, okanye ifilosofi apha ngasentla.
beliefs.deleteDesc: Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukucima le nkolelo? Oku akukwazi kubuyiselwa.

socialAnalysis.noAntiSocial: Akukho nto ingenayo eychasayo nentlalo okwangoku. Faka iinkolelo kwicandelo leziNkolelo.

disclaimer.title: Isilumkiso Sokugula Nokwengqondo
disclaimer.intro: Le app ("The ZINN App") yithuluzi elifundiswayo nelibuka ngokuzenzela elilawulwa yi-AI elingahlawumbi lomzikabango ongumlando ka-Maslow wamadiwa amanqanaba amahlanu.
disclaimer.section1Title: 1. Asiyona Izeluleko Yokugula, Yokwengqondo, Noma Yongokwengqondo
disclaimer.section1Body: Ubumnganga be-AI be-app buqwalasela amagama okanye okufakiwe ngumsebenzisi ukuze bahambisane namagama ejwayelekileyo omzimba wokuzimisela namadiwa angazalisekanga. Lo qwalaselo akuyona isimo sokuhlola ngokwengqondo ngokweklinikhi, ukuvivinywa kokwengqondo, ukuhlolwa kokugula okwengqondo, okanye icebo lokwelapha.
disclaimer.section2Title: 2. Akukho Budlelwano BukaDokotela Negulayo Noma BukaTherapeuthi Nomyenzeli
disclaimer.section2Body: Ukusebenzisa le app, amathrawuro ayo e-AI, nayo nayiphi na imveliso okanye izeluleko ekuqwalaseliwe akuyimfuneko yokuba ukho ebudlelwaneni noTherapeuthi Nomyenzeli, Dokotela Negulayo, okanye nosebenziswa olungophakathi kolunye ukuze kwakhe ubudlelwano bokunakekelwa kweempilo phakathi kwakho ne-The ZINN App.
disclaimer.section3Body: Le app ayinabungako bokulinganisa, ukuhlola, okanye ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo zengqondo. Ukuba uphila isimo esiphuthumayo ngokwengqondo, usizi olukhulu, okanye imicingo yokuzenzakalisa, nceda uxhume namasevisi ezingozini okanye nomgqa wamahhala ochwephehe abaprofayili bengqondo kule ndawo ngokukhawuleza.
disclaimer.section4Body: Zonke izeluleko eziveliswe yi-AI ziyangamagama okufundisa nokufundisa kuphela. Kufuneka njalo uxhume nopsikholoji oneleyisensi, udokotela bengqondo, okanye ochwephehe bokugula abaprofayili ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe kakhulu indlela yokuphila okanye yokuziphatha ngokusekwa kumveliso we-app. Ukusebenzisa le app kuphela ngokwakho ngokumelana neengozi.
disclaimer.acceptLabel: Ndiyifundile ndize ndiyiqonde iSilumkiso Sokugula Nokwengqondo. Ndiyamkele imgiba ndize ndazi ukuba le app yithuluzi lokufundisa, ayiyona isevisi yokugula okanye yokwengqondo.
disclaimer.contextual: Isilumkiso: Lo qwalaselo ulenzwa ngokuhlelwa kobunye obulawula nge-AI ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yomlando (Ukubekwa Kwamadiwa ka-Maslow) njengesalathisi sokufundisa. Imveliso ye-AI ingase ibe namaphutha okanye ingagqityi. Lo asiyona ithuluzi lokuhlola okanye lokuqwalasela ngokwengqondo. Nceda uxhume nochwephehe abaprofayili ukuba ufuna izeluleko ngokwengqondo okanye ukuhlolwa ngokumthethweni.
